item.description: Based in Current: Cambridge, Mass, USA Recent Stopovers: Moved from Cambridge, Mass (USA) to Paris, France (Summer 2023) Moved from Colombo, Sri Lanka in Summer of 2022 to Cambridge, Ma Read (Finished Last ~Couple Months) Bunker Hill by Nathaniel Philbrick Essays by Ralph Waldo Emerson Felicity by Mary Oliver Total Freedom by Krishnamurti Solaris by Stanislaw Lem The Overstory by Richard Powers Jumpstarting America by Jonathan Gruber and Simon Johnson 13 Bankers by Simon Johnson and James Kwak Zorba the Greek by Nikos Kazantzakis The Unbearable Lightness of Being by Milan Kundera Till We Have Faces by C.

Hey there! Thanks for checking out my website. I am a researcher and public interest technologist interested in finding ways to leverage technology to build participatory solutions that improve outcomes for vulnerable populations. I also love to go on adventures, read, and pursue a number of nerdy hobbies. You can find my professional details, contact information, what I’m currently up to (with a slight lag). Some stuff to check out while you are here:

Energy International Energy Agency Summer of 2023 I worked at the International Energy Agency on the Tracking Sustainable Transtions team. While there, I co-authored the IEA’s inagural flagship report on Clean Cooking. I also helped build the IEA’s Database on GIS resources for energy planning (designed to help build capacity for GIS-based energy planning within energy ministries on the African continent).
